description: Fetch a taxon profile: the taxonomic path, per-authority conservation listings, the encyclopedia summary, the photo gallery, immediate children, and observation counts. Resolve a name to a taxon id with inaturalist_resolve_name first. The upstream record is 95 KB for a common species, so it is projected before anything else happens; a taxon that still overflows comes back as an outline of its sections with their byte sizes, and naming those sections in a re-call returns only those. The valid section names are summary, taxonomy, children, conservation, photos, and encyclopedia.

sections.description: Sections to return: summary, taxonomy, children, conservation, photos, encyclopedia. Omit for the whole profile, or an outline of it when it overflows. A selection returns whatever it names, at whatever size, so sum the byte sizes from the outline before asking for several.

taxon_id.description: Numeric taxon id. A non-numeric value answers HTTP 422 with an empty message upstream, so the integer is enforced here. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

name: inaturalist_get_taxon

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

id.description: Taxon id of this ancestor — usable as taxon_id on any tool.

observations_count.description: How many observations this child taxon has. Null when upstream published none.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

anyOf.description: One conservation listing, by authority and place.

authority.description: The body that published this listing.

iucn.description: IUCN-normalised level upstream assigns this listing, on its own numeric scale.

place.description: Place the listing applies to. Null for a listing with global scope.

status.description: Authority-specific status, e.g. "Special Concern" or "G4"; distinct from the normalised csi filter.

url.description: Source page for the listing, when published.

global_status.description: Upstream global listing; null when none is recorded.

statuses.description: Every listing upstream records, one per authority and place.

items.description: One conservation listing, by authority and place.

authority.description: The body that published this listing.

iucn.description: IUCN-normalised level upstream assigns this listing, on its own numeric scale.

place.description: Place the listing applies to. Null for a listing with global scope.

status.description: Authority-specific status, e.g. "Special Concern" or "G4"; distinct from the normalised csi filter.

url.description: Source page for the listing, when published.

encyclopedia.description: The encyclopedia text and link upstream carries for the taxon.

wikipedia_summary.description: Verbatim encyclopedia text, including literal HTML tags.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: iNaturalist answered with an empty results array for that taxon id. `unknown_section`: sections named a key the projected document does not carry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

extinct.description: True when the taxon is recorded as extinct.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Insecta". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

is_active.description: False for a taxon superseded by a taxonomic change; its id still resolves.

kind.description: "full" when the profile itself is returned, "outline" when it overflowed and only the section list came back.

listed_taxa_count.description: Number of place checklists containing this taxon.

notice.description: How to re-call for specific sections. Present on the outline.

observations_count.description: How many observations carry this taxon or a descendant of it.

photos.description: Gallery photos, each with its own licence.

items.description: A taxon gallery photo with the attribution and licence that must travel with it.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

large_url.description: Upstream large image URL; absent when unpublished, never derived.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

rank_level.description: Numeric rank level — 70 kingdom, 30 family, 10 species, 5 subspecies.

sections.description: Available sections and their byte sizes, largest first. Present on the outline.

items.description: One section that can be named in a re-call, and what it costs.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

sections_applied.description: Sections this response carries. Empty when the whole profile came back, so an absent section means the taxon has none rather than that it was never asked for.

taxonomy.description: Ancestors from the root of the tree down to the taxon’s parent.

items.description: One rung of the taxonomic path, outermost first.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

id.description: Taxon id of this ancestor — usable as taxon_id on any tool.

vision.description: True when the taxon is covered by the upstream image classifier.

title: Inaturalist Get Taxon
